description: Returns the detailed record for one supplier in the SAAX Router index: identifier, name, description, services (name/endpoint/version), owner and source provenance. Call this after route_request or list_capabilities to inspect a specific supplier before preparing a commitment. Read-only; exact supplier_id match only (no enumeration). A registry entry is not a guarantee of service quality or verification.

supplier_id.description: The supplier identifier (agent_id from list_capabilities/route_request results, or its decimal string form)

name: get_supplier_details
title: Get supplier details
